proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9051 phala gives eastern phol/phar and Gujarati/Marathi phaḷ “fruit”, with phali “pod” separately discussed. Fruit responses fit directly; groundnut responses may involve specialization or shortening of a modern compound and remain under review. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.

The addendum notes a citra alternative for a neighboring form; the provisional family link retains that qualification and does not settle the remote reconstruction.
